text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, El Condor Pasa successfully 
completed her "first three years."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An overseas campaign. Naturally, 
preparations moved forward, and the day of 
departure arrived, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Koooooo, pyeeeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Immigration Officer
text_block_list.text: Nnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, an agitated condor and an 
immigration officer were having a 
staredown at the airport...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why, yes?! Why am I not allowed to leave 
the country with my mask on?!

text_block_list.name: Immigration Officer
text_block_list.text:
We can hardly allow a suspicious person 
wearing such a thing to travel overseas.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a suspicious person! El-El is the 
one and only El Condor Pasa, you know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you not see the Arima Kinen? That 
super-hot showdown with Grass and 
Spe-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Immigration Officer
text_block_list.text: I was working that day, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿Qué? Is that so... Thanks for your hard 
work...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Being slightly overpowered.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, I cannot take this mask 
off!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is a super-famous Umamusume now! No one 
can ever find out my true identity, desu!

text_block_list.name: Immigration Officer
text_block_list.text:
Then I cannot permit you to leave the 
country.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, if it's come to this, I've got to 
find some kind of excuse...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, exactly! Actually, this mask is an 
"eye mask," you see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"A bright cabin and flickering lights! But 
with this eye mask, I can sleep super 
soundly, YES!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So please, let me through.

text_block_list.name: Immigration Officer
text_block_list.text:
If it's an eye mask, please take it off 
for a moment.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No. Geez, you really are something else, 
you know that?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The conversation is going in circles. At 
this rate, we'll get nowhere.
choice_data_list: What if you gave up, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, you are right. At this rate, it 
doesn't look like they will let us 
through.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then El will just have to give in...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she understood.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so, we start over, YES! Let's head 
back for now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It seems El's fame still has a long way to 
go, *desu*! People doubt who I am unless I 
take off my mask, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, there's only one way! 
We'll just win, win, and keep on winning 
in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be so famous that I can breeze right 
through immigration without even taking 
off my mask, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's head back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected conclusion. And just like 
that, El Condor Pasa returned to the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm hoooome!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Grass...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a heavy heart, Grass Wonder saw El 
Condor Pasa off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What words do you say to your best friend 
when she returns in such pathetic defeat?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I told you, didn't I? It's impossible 
to do it with your mask on.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Siii...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "What a hopeless child... Good grief."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well, all right. Please get ready then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's have lunch together, and then go for 
a run. Just like we've always done.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass...! Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can see through everything. Here, there 
are friends who will welcome you no matter 
what mistakes you make.
